newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's April fishmeal output up 64 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's April fishmeal output up 64 percent.

text.p: Peru produced 371,400 tonnes of fishmeal in April, 64 percent more than in the same month last year, the Fisheries Ministry said Tuesday.
Production of Peru's second most important fish product, raw fish oil, was 79,200 tonnes in April, up from 61,600 tonnes in the same month last year, the ministry said.
Peru produced 673,600 tonnes of fishmeal in the first four months of the year, 12.2 percent more than in the same period last year.
Raw fish oil production in the January to April period was 134,400 tonnes, 8.9 percent more than in the first four months last year.
Peru, which has stepped up its exports by drawing down stocks in early 1997, was expected to exploit its April- September quota by July, according to the independent Oil World newsletter.
